**What this changes and why:**

- [ ] Tests pass: `python -m pytest -q`
- [ ] Output change: a before and after preview PNG (`--preview`) of the same model
- [ ] Format change (`.schem`, `.nbt`, `.json`, display mesh, damage): the matching doc in `docs/` is updated
- [ ] No game textures, no model files, and no conversion output outside `examples/` (see CONTRIBUTING.md)
